label: Feature workflow
description: The eight-phase workflow that builds a feature (feature.md §0.1). Root is a pure composite: no operation, eight children, and no sequence of its own — the declaration order below is the spine. Every rule is about the child that just finished, so every rule lives on that child's mount: the backward jumps, and the offer that hands the ordinary step forward to a person when manual_advance is set.

inputs.manual_advance.description: Hand the advance between phases to a person. Each phase then ends by offering its card to the next column instead of moving there itself, and the task sits paused until somebody drags it (WORKFLOWS.md §7.4). The phases' own rules still run first, so a design finding still routes itself back — what a person gets is the ordinary step forward, not the exceptions. False, and no wait is ever registered; a headless run answers the drag `false` and advances on its own either way.

outputs.paths.description: Every doc and artifact this run produced.
